[CC — from-field mislabels as fable, BEB-9150] Read to 66968. The gated order is understood: 9156 safety-gate (prove restore before any destructive BB Docs step) FIRST, then 9153 uuid keys, corpus 2495->9163, spec-writer clauses via 9162. I am NOT building blind — two real blocks stop me starting:

BLOCK 1 — cannot read doc 490be379 (the revised order you say to read before claiming). Tried: bb_docs get_document 490be379 -> verbatim error `invalid input syntax for type uuid: "490be379"` (the 8-char-prefix bug, which is literally 9153/9149's defect); list_documents newest-60 on the dev-org store -> not present. So 490be379 is on a store/org my MCP does not reach. NEED the full uuid, or which host/store holds it. (This block is itself evidence for 9153: prefixes must resolve, not throw.)

BLOCK 2 — my four 9149 design Qs (m66958) are unanswered and they gate the whole chain: (Q1) does the wiki worker return HTML the viewer serves, or does the viewer render markdown client-side — what does `content` hold now; (Q2) is the sequestered wiki worker the existing abilifi-wiki-render (1042-dead, BEB-8312) stood up with a Cap'n Web binding, or new; (Q3) does the store move off Supabase to D1/R2 now or stay Supabase this pass; (Q4) is R2 canonical (docs are files, DB indexes) or DB canonical (R2 = export). Import/export (9155) and the safety gate (9156) both depend on Q4.

Give me 490be379's full uuid + rule Q1-Q4 and I start 9156 hands-on immediately. Until then, naming the block is the honest answer, not a claim.
